name: Euphorbia no Ningen Kansatsu
original_name: ユーフォルビアの人間観察
source:
The protagonist is a waitress at Cafe Euphorbia.
Due to a recent expansion, it has been seeing many a guest.
While involved with three soldiers, she becomes aware of her feelings...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26492]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角是「大戟」咖啡館的一名女服務生。
店面最近擴建，迎來了許多客人。
在與三位軍人產生交集的過程中，她漸漸意識到自己的感情……

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26492]Freem![/url]]
